workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Brad, I've checked all the slots you listed against Priya and Marcus's calendars, and unfortunately NONE of them work for both of them:

- Tue 9:00-10:00: Priya is busy (Board prep + Partner lunch)
- Wed 13:00-14:00: Priya is busy (Client call + Client dinner prep)
- Thu 9:30-10:00: Priya is busy
- Thu 14:30-15:30: Marcus is busy (Dentist 14:30-15:00), and Priya is only free 14:30-15:00

There is zero overlap between (Priya & Marcus mutual free times) and (Elena & David mutual free times). This means no 30-minute slot exists where all four partners are free.

Can you double-check your analysis of Elena and David's calendars to make sure we haven't missed anything? If confirmed, we'll need to report this as infeasible.

workspace.text:
